title: Pink Ballerina Halloween Costume You Can Rewear
intro: A ballerina costume that does not live in a bin after October. The tulle tutu is the fun part, but the long sleeve wrap top, ballet pink tights, satin flats and ribbed leg warmers are real wardrobe pieces you will reach for all winter. Put it together with your hair in a high bun and it reads instantly, with zero glue, zero tutu shedding on the car seat and zero regret the next morning. Pink, soft and grown up enough for the office party, then the leg warmers go straight into your gym bag.

items.name: Pink long sleeve ballet wrap top
